pipeline_stages.name: Ingest
pipeline_stages.description: Stream Yelp JSON into SQLite via Kaggle download.

pipeline_stages.name: Sample
pipeline_stages.description: Stratified sample of 20K reviews across star ratings.

pipeline_stages.name: Preprocess
pipeline_stages.description: HTML unescape, URL strip, whitespace normalise, lowercase.

pipeline_stages.name: Graph
pipeline_stages.description: Node2Vec on user-business graph (64-dim per node).

pipeline_stages.name: Split
pipeline_stages.description: Group-disjoint train / val / test by user_id (11992/4011/3997).

pipeline_stages.name: Export
pipeline_stages.description: JSON artefacts for the Trust Chain website.

limitations: Pseudo-labels are heuristic, not ground truth - results are relative within the corpus.
The Wilcoxon test (p=0.25) was underpowered at three folds and could not confirm statistical significance.
Group-disjoint split prevents user leakage but cannot eliminate reviewer identity overlap across platforms.
GraphSAGE baseline reached only val PR-AUC 0.2842, indicating undertraining on this feature set.
SHAP explains the XGBoost model only, not the GraphSAGE baseline.
